rules.description: Embedded webui files are build artifacts, never hand-edited source
rules.why: That directory is the go:embed target of webui/dist; hand-edits are silently overwritten by make webui-build and drift from webui/src (source: Makefile webui-embed-check, incident class: lost UI edits)
rules.fix: Remove the tracked files (git rm --cached), edit webui/src instead, regenerate with make webui-build

rules.description: VERSION is defined exactly once — Makefile VERSION ?= is the single source of truth
rules.what: More (or fewer) than one 'VERSION ?=' occurrence among tracked files
rules.why: Duplicate version definitions desync releases — the Makefile is the release pipeline's input (source: .cursor/rules/release.mdc, tauri-to-go Phase 4)
rules.fix: Keep only the root Makefile assignment; read VERSION from make/bake elsewhere or pass it explicitly

rules.what: Tracked files under app/ (Tauri/Rust shell remnants)
rules.why: The shell was replaced by the pure-Go tray app in 0.2.0; resurrecting Tauri files reintroduces a deleted runtime and breaks the build graph (source: plan/done/tauri-to-go-shell.md)
rules.fix: Delete the files; the Go shell lives in cmd/rmb-app + internal/appshell

rules.description: Completed plans live in plan/done/, active plans in plan/
rules.check: test -d plan/done && test -f plan/local-first-desktop.md && echo ok
rules.what: plan/done/ or the active-plan set is missing/misplaced
rules.why: Plan lifecycle is the repo's decision history: active vs done must stay distinguishable for agents clocking in (source: repo convention 2026-08-24)
rules.fix: Move completed plans into plan/done/ in the same commit that completes them

rules.description: No stray debug prints in non-test Go code
rules.what: fmt.Println/Printf outside cmd/ (CLI user-facing output) and tests
rules.why: CLI output is user-facing: stray prints corrupt piped output and logs (source: general code-review category)
rules.fix: Route through the structured logger or remove; use t.Log in tests
